t0001.evidence: SSP 511: "The attributes shared by all engines in the EA211 family are: ... Camshaft driven via a toothed belt"; SSP 621 (A3 Sportback g-tron, French): "Moteur TFSI de 1,4l de la ligne EA 211 (81 kW)"; Audi SSP 616 (EA211 1.2/1.4 TFSI): "The crankshafts are driven by a toothed timing belt." (sic); vehicle use "Audi A3 '13", engine codes CJZA, CMBA, CPTA
t0001.note: No fixed belt change interval: repareo (secondary, Golf 7 data) says the maker prescribes no change interval for EA211 petrol belts and that the belt should be inspected from 240,000 km every 30,000 km.

t0002.evidence: 2013 Audi A3 spec book, 'Cylinder Head, Valvetrain - 2.0L CBEA (TDI)': "Camshaft toothed belt gear 25" [Nm], "Crankshaft toothed belt gear", "Rear toothed belt guard" (engine listed as "2.0L TDI CR (CBEA)"). ContiTech/Autobiz 2015: timing belt kit for "VW/Audi 1.6/2.0 TDI Common Rail Engines"; "Timing Belt Kit CT 1139 K2/WP2/WP6 therefore now replaces CT 1139 K1/WP1/WP4."
t0002.note: Model link: Haynes lists these codes for the generation; Haynes itself labels several of them 'CR TDI' on other VW group pages (e.g. CAYB/CAYC/CBDA/CBDB/CEGA/CFHC/CFJA/CFFB). The 1.6 CR belt rests on the ContiTech kit article (secondary); the 2.0 CR belt also on Audi's A3 (US, CBEA) spec book. Haynes 'A3 II 2003-2013'. The Audi spec book is for the US-market A3 (8P) 2.0L TDI CR, code CBEA; Europea

t0003.evidence: Gates TB020, AUDI DIESEL: "A3 ... 2.0 TDI PUMP NOZZLE AZV/BKD 2004 -> 120.000 120.000". SSP 841303 (1.9-Liter TDI with Pump Injection), 'Toothed Belt Drive': "These forces subject the components of the toothed belt drive to high loads. To relieve the load on the toothed belt, several modifications have been made."
t0003.note: Model link: Haynes lists these codes for the generation. Haynes 'A3 II 2003-2013'. Gates gives the interval only for AZV/BKD; 1.9 TDI BKC/BXE/BLS rely on SSP 841303 (1.9 PD belt). PD/CR switch year not sourced.
